summary: This is an 8-K filed by UFP Industries, Inc. reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting (Item 5.07) and a routine dividend declaration (Item 8.01). The meeting voted on director elections, ratification of auditors, and advisory executive compensation. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or activist campaign is present. The dividend increase is an ordinary capital return, not a transformative payout. Therefore, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
